whyUs.subtitle: WHY CHOOSE US
whyUs.title: A Higher Standard of Dental Care
whyUs.desc: We believe a visit to the dentist should feel safe, hygienic, and reassuring. Here is our commitment to every patient.
whyUs.point1Desc: All instruments are sealed in individual pouches and autoclaved to international hygiene standards.
whyUs.point2Desc: Trained dental surgeons registered with BMDC, upholding patient ethics and modern evidence-based practices.
whyUs.point3Desc: Instant digital dental X-rays with up to 90% less radiation for safe and precise diagnosis.
whyUs.point4Desc: We take extra care with anxious patients and children, explaining every step in plain language.
whyUs.point5Desc: No unnecessary treatments or hidden fees. We explain all your options and let you decide comfortably.
